subject: A review note covers the Dependabot omission setting in the Retornatus workflow.
source: Reviewed .github/workflows/retornatus.yml. Retornatus 1.9.1 scripts/github_action.sh treats src, tests, scripts, templates, pyproject.toml, and uv.lock as code and has no config key or action input that exempts paths or dependabot[bot]. requirements files and workflow files do not trip omission by themselves. Skipping the job with if would mark the required retornatus-gates check successful, per GitHub's status-check docs, and would also skip the suppressions gate, so the job still runs for every author. RETORNATUS_OMISSION is warn only when github.event.pull_request.user.login is dependabot[bot] and every changed file is a dependency manifest: requirements files, uv.lock, pyproject.toml limited to version pins under [project], [dependency-groups], or [project.optional-dependencies], and workflow files limited to uses pins. Any other diff keeps fail, so human and agent pull requests still fail omission when they change code without a Change. Checkout stays pinned to 3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1, permissions are unchanged, and actionlint passed.
